current_objective: Validate the second ORBYVEN 1.0 reliability milestone: universal safe recovery/retry presentation without duplicating bounded backend recovery flows or exposing raw provider failures.
last_completed: Re-audited current main after the Attention Inbox milestone and current concurrent integrations. No universal error boundary/retry presentation contract has landed; bounded recovery remains flow-specific.
Confirmed workspace modules already use sanitized user-facing load errors and reusable load callbacks, but the shared ModuleError surface is passive and does not express safe retry semantics.

Added a pure recovery presentation contract covering offline, timeout, rate limit, service unavailable, authentication, permission, not-found, conflict, validation and unknown states in Romanian and English.
Separated safe retry from uncertain non-idempotent writes: reads/idempotent writes can retry transient failures, while non-idempotent writes refresh authoritative state first to avoid duplicates.

Added a standalone premium RecoveryState component consuming only the sanitized presentation contract. It accepts retry/refresh callbacks but no Error object, provider payload, credentials or raw sensitive details.
Added regression coverage for retry safety, conflict refresh, no-retry authorization/validation states, secret/provider-field non-propagation, bilingual semantics and component contract.

The first PR #359 validation passed Architecture Guard, Quality Gate and CI. Main advanced during validation, so the branch was rebased instead of merging stale. Main advanced again through PR #358; its new web-design-studio ecosystem test was preserved while recovery was reapplied atomically.
Shared shell/navigation and existing bounded backend recovery endpoints were not modified.
